citation: Higgins M, et al. Characterizing the impact of primer-template mismatches on recombinase polymerase amplification
what_it_anchors: 3'-anchor-region mismatch classification for RPA primer design: per-terminal-mismatch log-odds of reaction success, and per-position classes over a 4-nt anchor
claim: Across 501 experiments and 315 unique mismatch combinations, 3543 of 4008 reactions succeeded (88.4%); a terminal C-C mismatch is the most detrimental to reaction success (probability 0.59), then G-A (0.62); A-C and T-G are the only terminal mismatches not significant for success (0.98 each)
claim_kind: primary supplement coefficients (S1, 12 terminal classes + 36 position classes), asserted against the paper's printed 0.59/0.62

citation: Wang Y, et al. Allele-specific recombinase polymerase amplification for rapid detection of multidrug-resistant tuberculosis
what_it_anchors: what an allele-specific RPA assay actually called on 141 clinical isolates
claim: Against Sanger sequencing the four assays called 10/0/0/131, 8/0/0/133, 28/0/0/113 (rpoB516/526/531) and 39/0/0/102 (katG315); against phenotype the combined rpoB assay detected 46 of 54 rifampicin-resistant isolates and missed 8 (14.8%), while katG315 missed 26 of 64 isoniazid-resistant isolates
claim_kind: CALL RATE against a reference, not a mismatch-position effect; 2x2s re-summed to N=141 and sensitivities recomputed

citation: Allele-specific recombinase polymerase amplification for sickle-cell genotyping
what_it_anchors: allele-level call performance of an AS-RPA design that relies on a penultimate mismatch
claim: betaA sensitivity 100.0% (34/34) and specificity 94.7% (54/57); betaS sensitivity 100.0% (57/57) and specificity 97.1% (33/34); accuracy 87/91 on the 3x3 genotype matrix
claim_kind: CALL RATE against IEF/HPLC genotype on 91 samples; no fold change or time-to-positive difference is reported
